notes.note: Reviewed the plugin-guide change against downstream README, integration and getting-started claims. Bounded retry of a rejected healthy-connection capability import changes transient bootstrap recovery only; persistent failure still offers Reload Station. Installation, consent, permissions, public setup and advertised capabilities remain unchanged;11 mounted boundary tests cover recovery/failure/outage/no-remount. Hosted capture remains separate evidence.
